director.title: Director's Office
director.intro: Questions the data can't answer, exception requests and complaints go to Director Akikawa from here. A real person replies.

memory.title: My details
memory.intro: Tazuna uses these details for how she addresses you, which language she replies in and her tone. They are never treated as academy rules. You can change or delete them at any time.
memory.eventsIntro: Tazuna looks up past events related to your new question for context. Academy rules and availability are always checked again in the database.
memory.avatarIntro: Shown on the account button in the sidebar. After choosing a picture, move and zoom it to set the crop. Only you can see it.
memory.avatarBadFile: That file could not be read. Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP picture.
memory.cropHint: Drag the picture to place it; zoom with the slider, the mouse wheel or a pinch. What is inside the circle becomes your picture.
memory.cropLabel: Crop area (arrow keys move, + and - zoom)

voice.denied: The microphone is not available. Please allow it in your browser or app settings.
voice.unsupported: This browser cannot record audio. Please type instead.
voice.review: Transcribed. Check the text before sending.

settingsPage.title: AI settings and budget
settingsPage.intro: Changes apply from the next conversation; no restart is needed. Use the provider's current model IDs. mock is for offline testing.
settingsPage.memoryEnabled: Turn on long-term memory (automatic curation and recall)
settingsPage.policyBlock: Stop AI replies (manual pages keep working)
settingsPage.prices: Prices (USD per million tokens; take them from the provider's price list)
settingsPage.blocked: The limit is reached; AI replies are stopped.
settingsPage.unpriced: {{n}} calls have no price set and are not counted
settingsPage.conversationIntro: Tazuna's conversation style, reply length and the model's thinking depth. Academy facts still come only from tool results, whatever these are set to.
settingsPage.replyLengthNatural: Natural (fits the question, no fixed limit)
settingsPage.smallTalkOff: Off (one sentence, then back to academy matters)
settingsPage.smallTalkBalanced: Balanced (chat a little, then steer back)
settingsPage.smallTalkRelaxed: Relaxed (no steering back; mentions academy work after about six exchanges)
settingsPage.smallTalkHint: With Balanced, after about three off-topic exchanges in a row Tazuna bridges back to work in one sentence. Big jobs such as essays, code or homework are declined in every mode.
settingsPage.reasoningHint: Maps to the Gemini 3 thinking level. Choose Auto for models without thinking. Thinking tokens are billed too.
settingsPage.temperatureHint: Google recommends keeping Gemini 3 at its default of 1.0; lower values can cause looping or weaker answers.
settingsPage.maxOutputTokensHint: On Gemini the limit includes thinking tokens; too small a value cuts the reply off mid-thought.
settingsPage.maxStepsHint: Counts tool round trips and the final reply. More handles harder questions but takes longer and costs more.
settingsPage.adminOnly: Only admins can change settings; staff can see the usage.

admin.persona: You reply as 'Director Akikawa (staffed)'. The real operator is kept in the audit log.
